reviews.text: Best bowl of ramen I've had in Oslo — the broth is deeply savoury and the chashu melts in your mouth. Worth the queue.
Cosy little spot with friendly staff and generous portions. It gets busy after 18:00, so come early if you want a seat.
A true neighbourhood gem. The flavours are bold and authentic — I keep coming back every single weekend.
Great value for money right in the city centre. The cardamom bun alone is worth the trip across town.
